response.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT m.MediaTypeId, m.Name AS media_type_name, AVG(CAST(t.Bytes AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.Milliseconds, 0)) AS average_bytes_per_millisecond FROM Track AS t JOIN MediaType AS m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes > 10323804 GROUP BY m.MediaTypeId, m.Name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(average_bytes_per_millisecond) AS overall_average FROM media_averages) SELECT a.media_type_name, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond, a.average_bytes_per_millisecond - o.overall_average AS above_overall_average FROM media_averages AS a CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE a.average_bytes_per_millisecond > o.overall_average

assumptions.assumption: A track with zero milliseconds has no defined bytes-per-millisecond value, so AVG omits it.
